title: docs(releases): say the Console UI builds from this repo's ui/, and add objectui to the 17.x skills remove roster

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:两处文档文字。发布说明总览页(`content/docs/releases/index.mdx`)改说 Console UI 由本仓 `ui/` 构建,「细粒度变更日志」一节不再指向已归档的 objectui CHANGELOG,改指各 `@object-ui/*` 包自带的 `CHANGELOG.md`;升级指南(`content/docs/upgrading.mdx`)17.x 的 `npx skills remove` 名单补上 `objectui`。
- 为什么改:18.2.0 起 Console 在本仓 `ui/` 构建,`@object-ui/*` 与 `@objectstack/*` 同一固定版本组;objectui 仓已归档,它的 CHANGELOG 不再更新。升级技能(`skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`)的名单已含 `objectui`,文档页与之不一致。
- 风险与回滚:只改文档文字,不发布(skip-changeset);带日期的各版本发布页(v12/v13/v14 仍链到 objectui CHANGELOG)按裁决保持原样。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`content/docs/releases/index.mdx` 第 6–11 行与第 41–45 行两个 hunk。
- 两分钟验证:`git grep -n 'objectstack-upgrade objectui -y' -- content/docs/upgrading.mdx skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`,预期两个文件各命中一行(两份 `skills remove` 名单一致)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`content/docs/releases/index.mdx` (the releases overview, not a dated release page):

- The opening paragraph says the Console UI is built from this repository's `ui/` workspace, whose `@object-ui/*` packages version in the same lockstep group, and is frozen into `@objectstack/console` at release time. It no longer says "built from the objectui repository".
- "Where the fine-grained changelogs live", the Console UI bullet: every `@object-ui/*` package under `ui/` ships its own changeset-generated `CHANGELOG.md` in the same release, as does `@objectstack/console`. Console changes from before 18.2.0 (built from the separate objectui repository) are summarized on the release pages for their versions. The link to the archived objectui `CHANGELOG.md` is dropped.

`content/docs/upgrading.mdx`, the "From 17.x to 18" skills step:

- The `npx skills remove` roster gains `objectui`, so it is again the same list as `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`.
- The sentence under the block says why `objectui` is there: a 17.x project installed it from the objectui repository, so the sync skips it like the `objectstack-*` skills.

## Why

- Since 18.2.0 the Console is built in this workspace from `ui/apps/console` (`packages/console/CHANGELOG.md`, 18.2.0 entry), and `.changeset/config.json` puts the `@object-ui/*` packages in the `@objectstack/*` fixed group. The objectui repository is archived, and its CHANGELOG gets no entries. `ui/CHANGELOG.md` in this repo is marked frozen history too, so the overview points at the per-package changelogs instead.
- PR #31152 added `objectui` to the upgrade skill's roster. The docs page kept the old list, and no gate holds the two equal.

## Tests

None owed: docs text only, no behaviour changed, so no test and no ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- **Dated release pages untouched.** v12 (L204), v13 (L188) and v14 (L298) still link the objectui CHANGELOG. They describe their own time; the order rules them out of scope.
- **Readers of these lines.** `git grep` for `objectui/blob/main/CHANGELOG` and `built from the [objectui]` outside `node_modules` hits only `content/docs/releases/index.mdx` and the three dated pages; no script, census or link checker reads those lines. `scripts/role-word-baseline.json` counts `content/docs/releases/index.mdx`; the new text adds no counted word (`pnpm check:role-word` below).
- `ui/.github/**` untouched.

## Verification

Gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (51 families for this diff), run on head `1ea1840d`, each exit code captured before any pipe:

- **51 run, exit 0 each.** `--ran`: "51 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 51 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 51 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)".
- First pass: five families answered a missing build prerequisite, not a finding (`check:doc-formula-expressions` and `check:doc-security-posture` exit 3, `check:skill-examples` exit 3, `check:docs-transcript-drift` exit 3, `check:docs` exit 1 "json-schema is missing"). After `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint...' --filter '@objectstack/client-react...' --filter '@objectstack/spec' build` under the verify lock (VERDICT command-exit 0), all five re-ran exit 0.
- `pnpm check:role-word` exit 0 (reads `content/docs/releases/index.mdx` against its baseline); `node scripts/check-nul-bytes.mjs` exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: no path-derived model mandate for this surface.
- `pnpm lint`: the diff touches no package, so there is no scoped package lint.
- CI families are read from this PR's check-runs, not re-run here.

`skip-changeset`: content under `content/docs/` ships in no package.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. (none added)
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (no package touched; docs only)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (publishes nothing: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [ ] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. Deliberate: this is the dedicated docs-only PR AGENTS.md's Documentation Guardrails name for a factual error on a releases page; only the maintained overview `index.mdx` moves, no dated page.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
